- E-mail: by sending the complaint to crpc@rbi.org.in.
- Physical mode: by sending the duly signed complaint form with supporting documents to Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre, Reserve Bank of India, Central Vista, Sector 17, Chandigarh - 160017.
